# Kigali Car Rental

> Kigali Car Rental offers self-drive and chauffeur-driven car rental in Kigali, Rwanda, from $30/day. Free airport delivery, full insurance, and 24/7 support. Fleet ranges from economy sedans to 4x4 Land Cruisers, minibuses, and safari vehicles.

## Fleet & Booking
- [Our Fleet](https://kigalicarrental.site/fleet): Full list of available vehicles with real-time pricing, filters, and rental requirements.
- [Book Now](https://kigalicarrental.site/book-now): Online booking form.
- [Pricing](https://kigalicarrental.site/pricing): Car rental rates from $30/day.
- [Pay Online](https://kigalicarrental.site/pay): Online payment for existing bookings.
